# Shared version configuration - single source of truth
# Loaded by Taskfile.yml via dotenv, inherited by all included taskfiles
# Tools are patch-pinned; base images are minor-pinned for automatic patch updates

# Go toolchain and build tools
# renovate: datasource=golang-version depName=golang versioning=semver extractVersion=^go(?<version>.*)$
GO_VERSION=1.26.5
# renovate: datasource=github-tags depName=go-swagger/go-swagger
SWAGGER_VERSION=v0.33.1
# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=golangci/golangci-lint
GOLANGCILINT_VERSION=v2.13.2
# renovate: datasource=go depName=golang.org/x/vuln
GOVULNCHECK_VERSION=v1.7.0
# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=cli/cli extractVersion=^v(?<version>.*)$
GH_CLI_VERSION=2.98.0

# Dev tools
# renovate: datasource=github-tags depName=air-verse/air
AIR_VERSION=v1.67.4
# renovate: datasource=github-tags depName=go-delve/delve
DELVE_VERSION=v1.27.1
# renovate: datasource=docker depName=oven/bun versioning=docker
BUN_VERSION=1.4.0
# renovate: datasource=docker depName=stoplight/spectral versioning=docker
SPECTRAL_VERSION=6.16.3
# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=helm/helm
HELM_VERSION=v4.2.4
# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=helm-unittest/helm-unittest
HELM_UNITTEST_VERSION=v1.1.2
# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=norwoodj/helm-docs extractVersion=^v(?<version>.*)$
HELM_DOCS_VERSION=1.14.2
# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=artifacthub/hub extractVersion=^v(?<version>.*)$
AH_VERSION=1.23.0
# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=oras-project/oras extractVersion=^v(?<version>.*)$
ORAS_VERSION=1.3.4
# renovate: datasource=npm depName=ajv-cli
AJV_CLI_VERSION=5.0.0
# renovate: datasource=docker depName=node versioning=docker
NODE_IMAGE_VERSION=22
# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=yaml/yamlscript
YS_VERSION=0.2.32
# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=helm/chart-testing extractVersion=^v(?<version>.*)$
CT_VERSION=3.14.0
# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=stackrox/kube-linter extractVersion=^v(?<version>.*)$
KUBE_LINTER_VERSION=0.8.3
# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=docker/compose
COMPOSE_VERSION=v5.5.0

# Base images (minor-pinned)
# renovate: datasource=docker depName=alpine versioning=docker
ALPINE_VERSION=3.24
# renovate: datasource=docker depName=8gears.container-registry.com/dhi.io/nginx versioning=docker
NGINX_VERSION=1.31
# renovate: datasource=docker depName=valkey/valkey versioning=docker
VALKEY_VERSION=8
# renovate: datasource=docker depName=postgres versioning=docker
POSTGRES_VERSION=16

# External dependencies
# renovate: datasource=github-tags depName=distribution/distribution
DISTRIBUTION_VERSION=v3.1.1
# renovate: datasource=docker depName=aquasec/trivy versioning=docker
TRIVY_VERSION=0.74.0
# renovate: datasource=docker depName=aquasec/trivy versioning=docker
TRIVY_BASE_IMAGE_VERSION=0.74.0
# renovate: datasource=github-tags depName=container-registry/harbor-scanner-trivy
HARBOR_SCANNER_TRIVY_VERSION=v0.40.1
# renovate: datasource=docker depName=ghcr.io/fivexl/lprobe versioning=docker
LPROBE_VERSION=0.2.0

# CI tooling
# renovate: datasource=npm depName=renovate
RENOVATE_VERSION=44.52.1
---
2.16.0
---
 Insecure Registries:
  EnableUserlandProxy: true
  UserlandProxyPath: /usr/bin/docker-proxy

observation.command: cat versions.env; echo ---; cat VERSION; echo ---; docker info 2>&1 | grep -i -E "registry|proxy|mirror|insecure"
